Header.name: CCSDS_OCM_VERS
Header.doc: Format version in the form of 'x.y', where 'y' is incremented for minor changes, and 'x' for major changes.

Header.name: COMMENT
Header.doc: Comments (a contiguous set of one or more comment lines may be provided immediately after the version number).

Header.name: CLASSIFICATION
Header.doc: User-defined free-text message classification/caveats of this OCM.

Header.name: MESSAGE_ID
Header.doc: Free-text field containing an ID that uniquely identifies a message from this originator.

Metadata.name: COMMENT
Metadata.doc: Comments in the Metadata section.

Metadata.name: OBJECT_NAME
Metadata.doc: Free-text field containing the name of the object.

Metadata.name: INTERNATIONAL_DESIGNATOR
Metadata.doc: International designator for the object as assigned by COSPAR.

Metadata.name: CATALOG_NAME
Metadata.doc: Satellite catalog source from which 'OBJECT_DESIGNATOR' was obtained.

Metadata.name: OBJECT_DESIGNATOR
Metadata.doc: Unique satellite identification designator from the catalog.

Metadata.name: ALTERNATE_NAMES
Metadata.doc: Alternate names of this space object.

Metadata.name: ORIGINATOR_POC
Metadata.doc: Originator or programmatic Point-of-Contact (PoC) for OCM.

Metadata.name: ORIGINATOR_POSITION
Metadata.doc: Contact position of the originator PoC.

Metadata.name: ORIGINATOR_PHONE
Metadata.doc: Originator PoC phone number.

Metadata.name: ORIGINATOR_EMAIL
Metadata.doc: Originator PoC email address.

Metadata.name: ORIGINATOR_ADDRESS
Metadata.doc: Originator's physical address information.

Metadata.name: TECH_ORG
Metadata.doc: Creating agency or operator for technical contact.

Metadata.name: TECH_POC
Metadata.doc: Technical Point-of-Contact (PoC) for OCM.

Metadata.name: TECH_POSITION
Metadata.doc: Contact position of the technical PoC.

Metadata.name: TECH_PHONE
Metadata.doc: Technical PoC phone number.

Metadata.name: TECH_EMAIL
Metadata.doc: Technical PoC email address.

Metadata.name: TECH_ADDRESS
Metadata.doc: Technical PoC physical address information.

Metadata.name: PREVIOUS_MESSAGE_ID
Metadata.doc: ID that uniquely identifies the previous message from this originator.

Metadata.name: NEXT_MESSAGE_ID
Metadata.doc: ID that uniquely identifies the next message from this originator.

Metadata.name: ADM_MSG_LINK
Metadata.doc: Unique identifier of Attitude Data Messages linked to this OCM.

Metadata.name: CDM_MSG_LINK
Metadata.doc: Unique identifier of Conjunction Data Messages linked to this OCM.

Metadata.name: PRM_MSG_LINK
Metadata.doc: Unique identifier of Pointing Request Messages linked to this OCM.

Metadata.name: RDM_MSG_LINK
Metadata.doc: Unique identifier of Reentry Data Messages linked to this OCM.

Metadata.name: TDM_MSG_LINK
Metadata.doc: List of Tracking Data Messages upon which this orbit determination is based.

Metadata.name: OPERATOR
Metadata.doc: Operator of the space object.

Metadata.name: OWNER
Metadata.doc: Owner of the space object.

Metadata.name: COUNTRY
Metadata.doc: Country where the space object owner is based.

Metadata.name: CONSTELLATION
Metadata.doc: Name of the constellation to which this space object belongs.

Metadata.name: OBJECT_TYPE
Metadata.doc: Specification of the type of object (e.g., PAYLOAD, ROCKET BODY, DEBRIS).

Metadata.name: TIME_SYSTEM
Metadata.doc: Time system for all absolute time stamps in this OCM, including EPOCH_TZERO.

Metadata.name: EPOCH_TZERO
Metadata.doc: Default epoch to which all relative times are referenced in data blocks.

Metadata.name: OPS_STATUS
Metadata.doc: Specification of the operational status of the space object.

Metadata.name: ORBIT_CATEGORY
Metadata.doc: Specification of the type of orbit (e.g., GEO, LEO).

Metadata.name: OCM_DATA_ELEMENTS
Metadata.doc: List of elements of information data blocks included in this message.

Metadata.name: SCLK_OFFSET_AT_EPOCH
Metadata.doc: Number of spacecraft clock counts at EPOCH_TZERO (used if TIME_SYSTEM is SCLK).

Metadata.name: SCLK_SEC_PER_SI_SEC
Metadata.doc: Number of clock seconds occurring during one SI second (used if TIME_SYSTEM is SCLK).

Metadata.name: PREVIOUS_MESSAGE_EPOCH
Metadata.doc: Creation epoch of the previous message from this originator.

Metadata.name: NEXT_MESSAGE_EPOCH
Metadata.doc: Anticipated (or actual) epoch of the next message from this originator.

Metadata.name: START_TIME
Metadata.doc: Time of the earliest data contained in the OCM.

Metadata.name: STOP_TIME
Metadata.doc: Time of the latest data contained in the OCM.

Metadata.name: TIME_SPAN
Metadata.doc: Span of time that the OCM covers, measured in days.

Metadata.name: TAIMUTC_AT_TZERO
Metadata.doc: Difference (TAI - UTC) in seconds at EPOCH_TZERO.

Metadata.name: NEXT_LEAP_EPOCH
Metadata.doc: Epoch of next leap second.

Metadata.name: NEXT_LEAP_TAIMUTC
Metadata.doc: Difference (TAI - UTC) in seconds at NEXT_LEAP_EPOCH.

Metadata.name: UT1MUTC_AT_TZERO
Metadata.doc: Difference (UT1 - UTC) in seconds at EPOCH_TZERO.

Metadata.name: EOP_SOURCE
Metadata.doc: Source and version of Earth Orientation Parameters used.

Metadata.name: INTERP_METHOD_EOP
Metadata.doc: Method used to select or interpolate sequential EOP data.

Metadata.name: CELESTIAL_SOURCE
Metadata.doc: Source and version of celestial body ephemeris data used.

StateVector.name: X
StateVector.doc: X component of position in the specified reference frame.

PhysicalProperties.name: COMMENT
PhysicalProperties.doc: Comments in the Physical Properties section.

PhysicalProperties.name: WET_MASS
PhysicalProperties.doc: Wet mass of the space object.

PhysicalProperties.name: DRY_MASS
PhysicalProperties.doc: Dry mass of the space object.

PhysicalProperties.name: OEB_Q1
PhysicalProperties.doc: Quaternion component q1 of orientation from OEB to EME2000.

PhysicalProperties.name: OEB_MAX
PhysicalProperties.doc: Maximum dimension of the object along OEB frame axes.

PhysicalProperties.name: OEB_INT
PhysicalProperties.doc: Intermediate dimension along OEB frame axes.

PhysicalProperties.name: OEB_MIN
PhysicalProperties.doc: Minimum dimension of the object along OEB frame axes.

PhysicalProperties.name: SRP_CONST_AREA
PhysicalProperties.doc: Constant area for solar radiation pressure computations.

PhysicalProperties.name: SRP_UNCERTAINTY
PhysicalProperties.doc: Uncertainty in the solar radiation pressure coefficient.

Perturbations.name: GM
Perturbations.doc: Gravitational constant times the mass of the central body.

Perturbations.name: N_BODY_PERTURBATIONS
Perturbations.doc: List of celestial bodies included in n-body perturbations.

Perturbations.name: FIXED_F10P7
Perturbations.doc: Fixed F10.7 solar flux value used.

Perturbations.name: FIXED_F10P7_MEAN
Perturbations.doc: Fixed mean F10.7 solar flux value used.

Perturbations.name: FIXED_GEOMAG_AP
Perturbations.doc: Fixed (time-invariant) geomagnetic index ap used in place of the normal time-varying values (CCSDS 502.0-B-3 FIXED_GEOMAG_AP).

Maneuver.name: MAN_ID
Maneuver.doc: Unique identifier for the maneuver.

Maneuver.name: MAN_BASIS
Maneuver.doc: Basis of the maneuver plan (e.g., planned, predicted, estimated).

Maneuver.name: MAN_DEVICE_ID
Maneuver.doc: Identifier of the maneuver device.

Maneuver.name: MAN_PREV_ID
Maneuver.doc: Identifier of the previous maneuver.

Maneuver.name: MAN_PURPOSE
Maneuver.doc: Purpose of the maneuver.

Maneuver.name: MAN_REF_FRAME
Maneuver.doc: Reference frame for the maneuver data.

Maneuver.name: MAN_FRAME_EPOCH
Maneuver.doc: Epoch of the maneuver reference frame.

Maneuver.name: MAN_TYPE
Maneuver.doc: Type of maneuver (e.g., IMPULSIVE, FINITE).

Maneuver.name: MAN_EPOCH_START
Maneuver.doc: Start epoch of the maneuver.

Maneuver.name: MAN_DURATION
Maneuver.doc: Duration of the maneuver.

Maneuver.name: MAN_UNITS
Maneuver.doc: Units for the maneuver data values.

Maneuver.name: DATA
Maneuver.doc: Data associated with the maneuver.

Maneuver.name: MAN_COMMENT
Maneuver.doc: Comments related to the maneuver.

Maneuver.name: MAN_COMPOSITION
Maneuver.doc: Ordered DATA columns, including TIME_ABSOLUTE or TIME_RELATIVE first. CCSDS 502.0-B-3 Tables 6-7 to 6-9; absent means composition unspecified. DATA entries are complete time-history lines; MAN_UNITS excludes time tags. Relative time tags are seconds from METADATA.EPOCH_TZERO.

Maneuver.name: MAN_NEXT_ID
Maneuver.doc: Next maneuver identifier (CCSDS 502.0-B-3 Table 6-7).

Maneuver.name: MAN_BASIS_ID
Maneuver.doc: OD, navigation solution or simulation identifier (Table 6-7).

Maneuver.name: MAN_PREV_EPOCH
Maneuver.doc: Previous maneuver completion: absolute epoch or seconds from EPOCH_TZERO. CCSDS 502.0-B-3 Table 6-7; absolute times use METADATA.TIME_SYSTEM.

Maneuver.name: MAN_NEXT_EPOCH
Maneuver.doc: Next maneuver start; same time convention as MAN_PREV_EPOCH (Table 6-7).

Maneuver.name: MAN_PRED_SOURCE
Maneuver.doc: Source of predicted orbit or attitude states (Table 6-7).

Maneuver.name: GRAV_ASSIST_NAME
Maneuver.doc: Gravitational assist body name (Table 6-7).

Maneuver.name: DC_TYPE
Maneuver.doc: CONTINUOUS, TIME or TIME_AND_ANGLE; absent means CONTINUOUS (Table 6-7).

Maneuver.name: DC_WIN_OPEN
Maneuver.doc: Duty-cycle window start; MAN_PREV_EPOCH time convention (Table 6-7).

Maneuver.name: DC_WIN_CLOSE
Maneuver.doc: Duty-cycle window end; MAN_PREV_EPOCH time convention (Table 6-7).

Maneuver.name: DC_MIN_CYCLES
Maneuver.doc: Minimum and maximum ON cycles; HAS_DC_*_CYCLES marks presence (Table 6-7).

Maneuver.name: HAS_DC_MIN_CYCLES
Maneuver.doc: Presence of the corresponding cycle bound; zero remains representable.

Maneuver.name: DC_EXEC_START
Maneuver.doc: First and final duty-cycle sequence times; MAN_PREV_EPOCH convention. Required with DC_WIN_OPEN/CLOSE when DC_TYPE is not CONTINUOUS (Table 6-7).

Maneuver.name: DC_REF_TIME
Maneuver.doc: Duty-cycle reference time; MAN_PREV_EPOCH time convention (Table 6-7).

Maneuver.name: DC_TIME_PULSE_DURATION
Maneuver.doc: Pulse ON duration and start-to-start period, seconds; NaN means absent (Table 6-7). Required with DC_REF_TIME for non-continuous cycles; period >= duration.

Maneuver.name: DC_REF_DIR
Maneuver.doc: Three-component reference unit direction in MAN_REF_FRAME (Table 6-7). Required with DC_BODY_FRAME/TRIGGER and both angles for TIME_AND_ANGLE.

Maneuver.name: DC_BODY_FRAME
Maneuver.doc: Body frame of DC_BODY_TRIGGER (Table 6-7).

Maneuver.name: DC_BODY_TRIGGER
Maneuver.doc: Three-component body-frame trigger unit direction (Table 6-7).

Maneuver.name: DC_PA_START_ANGLE
Maneuver.doc: Pulse start and stop phase angles, degrees; NaN means unspecified. CCSDS 502.0-B-3 Table 6-7.

OrbitDetermination.name: OD_METHOD
OrbitDetermination.doc: Method used for orbit determination.

OrbitDetermination.name: OD_EPOCH
OrbitDetermination.doc: Epoch of the orbit determination.

OrbitDetermination.name: OD_TIME_TAG
OrbitDetermination.doc: Time tag of the orbit determination.

OrbitDetermination.name: OD_PROCESS_NOISE
OrbitDetermination.doc: Process noise model used.

OrbitDetermination.name: OD_COV_REDUCTION
OrbitDetermination.doc: Covariance reduction techniques used.

OrbitDetermination.name: OD_NOISE_MODELS
OrbitDetermination.doc: Noise models used.

OrbitDetermination.name: OD_OBSERVATIONS_TYPE
OrbitDetermination.doc: Types of observations used (e.g., RANGE, DOPPLER).

OrbitDetermination.name: OD_OBSERVATIONS_USED
OrbitDetermination.doc: Number of observations used.

OrbitDetermination.name: OD_TRACKS_USED
OrbitDetermination.doc: Number of tracks used.

OrbitDetermination.name: OD_DATA_WEIGHTING
OrbitDetermination.doc: Data weighting scheme used.

OrbitDetermination.name: OD_CONVERGENCE_CRITERIA
OrbitDetermination.doc: Convergence criteria used.

OrbitDetermination.name: OD_EST_PARAMETERS
OrbitDetermination.doc: Parameters estimated during orbit determination.

OrbitDetermination.name: OD_APRIORI_DATA
OrbitDetermination.doc: A priori data used for orbit determination.

OrbitDetermination.name: OD_RESIDUALS
OrbitDetermination.doc: Residuals from the orbit determination.

OrbitDetermination.name: OD_ESTIMATOR
OrbitDetermination.doc: Estimator class provenance: batch fit vs sequential filter (EKF/UKF).

OrbitDetermination.name: OD_RESIDUAL_RMS
OrbitDetermination.doc: RMS of post-fit residuals for this solution.

OrbitDetermination.name: OD_RESIDUALS_SERIES
OrbitDetermination.doc: Post-fit residual series, one entry per accepted observation.

OrbitDetermination.name: OD_RESIDUAL_EPOCHS
OrbitDetermination.doc: Epochs aligned with OD_RESIDUALS_SERIES (UNIX timestamp) [numeric seconds since 1970-01-01T00:00:00 UTC].

OrbitDetermination.name: OD_BATCH_BASELINE_ID
OrbitDetermination.doc: OD_ID of the batch baseline solution a filtered solution derives from and is compared against (empty for batch solutions).

OrbitDetermination.name: OD_BATCH_BASELINE_RMS
OrbitDetermination.doc: Post-fit residual RMS of the batch baseline, for direct batch-vs-filter comparison.

OrbitDetermination.name: SEDR
OrbitDetermination.doc: Specific energy dissipation rate in W/kg: energy removed from the orbit by non-conservative forces, averaged during the OD (CCSDS 502.0-B-3 SEDR).

OrbitDetermination.name: WEIGHTED_RMS
OrbitDetermination.doc: Weighted RMS residual ratio of a batch OD (CCSDS 502.0-B-3 WEIGHTED_RMS).

OCM.name: HEADER
OCM.doc: Header section of the OCM.

OCM.name: METADATA
OCM.doc: Metadata section of the OCM.

OCM.name: TRAJ_TYPE
OCM.doc: Trajectory state representation type. Determines how orbit state data is parameterized in this message. For CARTESIAN_PV/CARTESIAN_PVA, use STATE_DATA array. For POLYNOMIAL_POS/POLYNOMIAL_OE, use the corresponding polynomial record arrays.

OCM.name: TRAJ_TYPE_DESCRIPTION
OCM.doc: Legacy trajectory type string for backward compatibility and extended types (e.g., "PROPAGATED", "ESTIMATED", "FILTERED").

OCM.name: STATE_STEP_SIZE
OCM.doc: Time interval between state vectors in seconds; required without STATE_EPOCHS.

OCM.name: STATE_VECTOR_SIZE
OCM.doc: Number of components per state vector. 6 = position + velocity (X, Y, Z, X_DOT, Y_DOT, Z_DOT) 9 = position + velocity + acceleration (adds X_DDOT, Y_DDOT, Z_DDOT) 6 or 7 for the element sets named by TRAJ_TYPE.

OCM.name: STATE_DATA
OCM.doc: State data as row-major array of doubles. Layout: [X0, Y0, Z0, X_DOT0, Y_DOT0, Z_DOT0, X1, Y1, Z1, ...] Time reconstruction uses STATE_EPOCHS when present, otherwise START_TIME + i * STATE_STEP_SIZE. Length must be divisible by STATE_VECTOR_SIZE. Units: km, km/s and km/s**2, in TRAJ_REF_FRAME about CENTER_NAME.

OCM.name: COVARIANCE_DATA
OCM.doc: Covariance data as flat array (21 elements per epoch for 6x6 lower triangular). Time alignment matches STATE_DATA epochs.

OCM.name: POLYNOMIAL_POSITION_RECORDS
OCM.doc: Polynomial position records. Used when TRAJ_TYPE is POLYNOMIAL_POS. Each record covers a time segment with polynomial coefficients for X, Y, Z position (and optionally velocity). See PPE schema for record structure and evaluation procedure.

OCM.name: POLYNOMIAL_OE_RECORDS
OCM.doc: Polynomial orbital element records. Used when TRAJ_TYPE is POLYNOMIAL_OE. Each record covers a time segment with polynomial coefficients for classical orbital elements. See PPE schema for record structure and evaluation procedure.

OCM.name: PHYSICAL_PROPERTIES
OCM.doc: Physical properties of the space object.

OCM.name: MANEUVER_DATA
OCM.doc: Maneuver data.

OCM.name: PERTURBATIONS
OCM.doc: Perturbations parameters used.

OCM.name: ORBIT_DETERMINATION
OCM.doc: Orbit determination data.

OCM.name: USER_DEFINED_PARAMETERS
OCM.doc: User-defined parameters and supplemental comments.

OCM.name: CENTER_NAME
OCM.doc: Origin of TRAJ_REF_FRAME (EARTH, MOON, ...) (CCSDS 502.0-B-3 CENTER_NAME).

OCM.name: TRAJ_REF_FRAME
OCM.doc: Reference frame of STATE_DATA and the polynomial records (CCSDS 502.0-B-3 TRAJ_REF_FRAME).

OCM.name: TRAJ_FRAME_EPOCH
OCM.doc: Epoch of TRAJ_REF_FRAME when it is not intrinsic to the frame (CCSDS 502.0-B-3 TRAJ_FRAME_EPOCH).

OCM.name: COV_REF_FRAME
OCM.doc: Reference frame of COVARIANCE_DATA (CCSDS 502.0-B-3 COV_REF_FRAME).

OCM.name: ORB_REVNUM
OCM.doc: Orbit revolution number at the first state (CCSDS 502.0-B-3 ORB_REVNUM).

OCM.name: ORB_AVERAGING
OCM.doc: For element sets: OSCULATING, or the mean-element theory used (BROUWER, KOZAI, ...) (CCSDS 502.0-B-3 ORB_AVERAGING). Absent means OSCULATING.

OCM.name: COV_CALIBRATION
OCM.doc: Whether COVARIANCE_DATA's coverage was measured against independent reference states.

OCM.name: COV_CALIBRATION_REFERENCE
OCM.doc: Identifier of that calibration evidence (a report or record).

OCM.name: STATE_EPOCHS
OCM.doc: Absolute epoch per STATE_DATA row in METADATA.TIME_SYSTEM (CCSDS 502.0-B-3 section 6.2.4). When nonempty, length equals STATE_DATA.length / STATE_VECTOR_SIZE and these epochs override START_TIME + i * STATE_STEP_SIZE. Absent or empty retains the uniform grid; COVARIANCE_DATA shares these epochs.
